description: This file defines the 'ImportDuplicateCheck' class responsible for performing duplicate record checks during data import in SuiteCRM, including methods for retrieving indexes, detecting duplicates based on fields or indexes, and managing related functionalities.

classes.name: ImportDuplicateCheck
classes.description: Handles duplicate record checks during import, including index management and duplicate detection logic.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the ImportDuplicateCheck object with a focus bean.

methods.name: _getIndexVardefs
methods.description: Retrieves index definitions for the focus bean, including custom and email indexes.

methods.name: getDuplicateCheckIndexes
methods.description: Returns human-readable labels for the indexes used in duplicate checking.

methods.name: isADuplicateRecordByFields
methods.description: Checks if the current bean is a duplicate based on specified fields.

methods.name: isADuplicateRecord
methods.description: Checks if the current bean is a duplicate based on index definitions.

methods.name: getDuplicateCheckIndexedFiles
methods.description: Returns indexed fields suitable for duplicate checking during import.
